Anyswap is a cross-chain router protocol for transferring tokens between public blockchains. Anyswap was later rebranded as Multichain.

Axelar is a blockchain interoperability network that enables cross-chain communication. Axelar is built on the Cosmos SDK and uses Tendermint consensus. Axelar relies on a proof-of-stake validator set secured by its own network.

Gnosis develops the Gnosis Safe multisignature smart contract wallet. Gnosis operates Gnosis Chain, an EVM-compatible blockchain formerly known as xDai. Gnosis has built conditional token frameworks for prediction markets.
